description: While working fz-bin.16, fz2 interp for fixtures2/behavior/enum_take_drop_split.fz now prints the full expected stream after moving the runtime callbacks onto reduce_while-friendly single-clause reducers. fz2 run and fz2 build execute without native lowering panics, but their stdout keeps only the newest cons cell in accumulator-built lists (for example Enum.take([1,2,3,4,5], 3) prints [3] instead of [1,2,3]). This is a native/JIT/AOT correctness blocker for re-enabling run/build on the fixture.
